terra.problem: Micah's role as a prophet carrying the message is a fact outside this passage and needs a reference.
Calling bribes and stolen land a 'juicy list' makes light of serious wrongdoing.
The explanation adds a reason for God pointing at their houses, although the text gives no such reason and does not say He points at their houses.
Micah 6:8 does not specifically say God asked for honest dealing; it calls for justice, mercy, and walking humbly with God.
Papa claims he has dodged bill collectors. That invents a part of his life outside his established world.
The statement about no one being asked to hand anything over at the table adds a scene and detail the text does not give.
The verse does not say this represents a farmer's whole year of work or that there will be nothing at the end.
The passage says they will sow but not reap. It does not say the seed never becomes a harvest.
The cited verses do not establish that Ahab ruled after Omri. That fact needs a reference such as 1 Kings 16:28.
The verse says the city will bear the nations' scorn. It does not say the nations are only looking down on them or that they hand nothing over.
